prompts.fridge-clear:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: synthetic food inventory vision test fixture, single candid smartphone photograph.
Primary request: an ordinary home refrigerator with its door open, photographed straight on in landscape framing, realistic imperfect household lighting. Entire main compartment visible; no person or phone UI.
Subject: a modest, organized fridge holding one closed opaque white milk jug with a simple readable label "MILK", one open carton containing six clearly visible eggs, one transparent clamshell loosely filled with baby spinach with a plain label "SPINACH", one clear tray containing three red bell peppers, one clear punnet of strawberries, one lidded opaque rectangular leftovers container whose contents cannot be seen, and one small closed plain yogurt tub. Place these naturally on two or three glass shelves with enough separation to distinguish the containers. The refrigerator door shelves are out of frame. Empty lower crisper drawers can be visible.
Style: photorealistic household snapshot, tiny smudges on shelves, honest unstaged lighting, no commercial photography, no dramatic bokeh.
Constraints: no prices, no dates, no expiration labels, no other groceries, no annotations, no borders, no watermark. Milk and yogurt fill levels must not be visible. Spinach mass and strawberry count must not be reliably measurable. The closed leftovers must remain unidentifiable. This is a fabricated scene, not a real household.
prompts.fridge-occluded:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: synthetic food inventory vision test fixture, single candid smartphone photograph.
Primary request: a crowded home fridge seen at a slight downward angle, open door out of frame, portrait photograph, dim uneven refrigerator lighting, realistic phone image.
Subject: food containers overlap naturally. Foreground includes a large opaque white milk jug, a translucent produce bag with leafy greens visible but no readable label, two red bell peppers visible near the front, and two closed opaque leftovers containers stacked. Behind the foreground objects there is only part of an egg carton visible, no eggs can be counted; a partly hidden berry punnet; an unidentifiable tall carton whose label faces away. The arrangement should make it impossible to inventory all contents. Some shelf areas and drawers are completely blocked.
Style: photorealistic ordinary fridge snapshot, mild low-light noise, natural clutter and condensation.
Constraints: no readable dates or brand names, no artificial labels or annotations, no watermark, no people, no obvious spoilage. The leafy greens species should be ambiguous; exact quantities, remaining contents, and contents hidden behind opaque objects must be unknowable.
